outcome: Intraoperative massive hemorrhage during suction curettage for cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: The study included 90 patients undergoing suction curettage for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) after focused ultrasound ablation surgery (FUAS).
finding: The preoperative Cesarean Section Diverticulum (CSD) area significantly predicted intraoperative massive hemorrhage during suction curettage after Focused Ultrasound Ablation Surgery (FUAS) for Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP).
